comment: M5-037: the vehicle seat source table. One row binds one seat to one vehicle: the first version supports exactly the single 'driver' role (gunner and passenger roles of multi-seat layouts are refused), seat_location_cm and exit_offset_cm are centimeter offsets relative to the vehicle origin (X lateral, Y depth, Z height) and each vehicle may carry at most one seat - a second seat row for the same vehicle is rejected by the cross-table gate.
